messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — we just confirmed a partial failure in the billing-ledger sync that hit trial->paid onboarding flows for a small set of customers (3 tenants). Seeing stalled seat assignments and webhook retries. Planning proactive customer comms.

alex_se: Thanks Maria. We're rolling a scoped hotfix to the webhook backoff logic now — ETA ~15m to first canary. Root cause looks like an unexpected 502 path from the ledger service when requests are retried quickly.

jordan_pmo: Important for renewals: two of the affected tenants are mid-quarter renewal prospects. We should include a mitigation + credit offer. Draft message?

maria_cs: Drafting a short customer note now. Key asks: confirm impact window, mitigation steps we're taking, offer 5% invoice credit + 2 hours of onboarding support, and invite to a dedicated office hours. Will share the copy in a sec. :pencil2:

emily_rev: 5% credit ok for the three? For the mid-quarter accounts we may want 10% if they're high ARR and at risk. I'll DM specifics.

luis_support: I pulled the CS ticket queue — two active tickets from TenantA and TenantC, TenantB opened an inbound support session earlier and reported seat assignment failures. I'm on the line with TenantC now.

sarah_ops: Can we get a one-click promo code or credit script? Need to ensure billing ops doesn't need manual intervention for each tenant during the outage window.

alex_se: We'll add an automated credit script hook after hotfix verification. I'll coordinate with billing once canary is green.

maria_cs: Draft customer note (short):
```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We experienced a temporary error in our billing-ledger sync between 09:02 and 09:40 UTC that may have prevented trial seat assignments from completing. We rolled a fix and requeued outstanding tasks; most affected accounts should be stable now.

What we're doing:
• Hotfix to webhook retry/backoff (deployed).
• Automated retry of pending ledger tasks.
• Proactive 5% invoice credit and 2 hours of onboarding help for affected tenants; if you're a renewal-priority account we'll follow up with an adjusted offer.

If you still see issues, reply here or open a support ticket and we'll prioritize.
Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success
```

jordan_pmo: Good concise copy. Add a line about collecting feedback — short form link and optional feedback call. Keeps the PSAT loop tight.

maria_cs: Adding feedback call and short form. Draft with links: feedback form: https://redwood.io/incident-feedback (placeholder) and office hours sign-up.

deploy-bot: Hotfix canary deployed at 3651230100 — 1/3 workers. No elevated errors in canary window.

alex_se: Canary looks clean. Rolling remainder now. Will post when fully rolled (estimating +6m).

luis_support: Noted. I'll update the two open tickets with the message and escalate TenantA to priority because of renewal timeline.

emily_rev: I'll prepare tailored outreach for the two renewal-risk accounts and join the exec call if needed.

sarah_ops: Billing ops — I'll queue the automated credit script as soon as you confirm the final list. Please ping when deploy finishes.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. Action items: (1) Alex finish rollout and confirm, (2) Luis update tickets + outbound notes, (3) Sarah trigger credit script when list ready, (4) Emily/jordan handle renewal-specific offers. I'll push the final customer message once Alex confirms full rollout.

alex_se: Full rollout completed at 3651230280. No regressions in the last 2m.

maria_cs: Message sent to affected tenants at 3651230290. I'll follow up with an internal post-incident note and a quick PSAT capture in 24h. If anyone needs access to the list of affected tenants DM me. :thumbsup:
